documents.title: Clause library — CL-101 New York Governing Law
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-101
Category: New York Governing Law
Library slug: governing_law_ny
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or relating to it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles. The parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-102 England Governing Law
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-102
Category: England Governing Law
Library slug: governing_law_england
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. The courts of England shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-103 Governing Law excluding UCC or other similar regulatory frameworks
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-103
Category: Governing Law excluding UCC or other similar regulatory frameworks
Library slug: governing_law_carveout
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, expressly excluding the Uniform Commercial Code and any other body of law that would apply the law of another jurisdiction to the parties' dealings.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-104 Limitation of Liability capped at fees paid
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-104
Category: Limitation of Liability capped at fees paid
Library slug: limitation_of_liability_capped
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Except for the Excluded Claims, each party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable by Customer to Supplier in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-105 Limitation of Liability with uncapped carve-outs
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-105
Category: Limitation of Liability with uncapped carve-outs
Library slug: limitation_of_liability_uncapped_carveout
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. The limitations in this Section shall not apply to (a) a party's indemnification obligations for third-party intellectual-property claims, (b) breach of confidentiality, (c) gross negligence or willful misconduct, or (d) a party's payment obligations, each of which shall be uncapped.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-106 Limitation of Liability with a super-cap for data incidents
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-106
Category: Limitation of Liability with a super-cap for data incidents
Library slug: limitation_of_liability_supercap
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Supplier's aggregate liability for claims arising from a Security Incident shall not exceed three (3) times the fees paid in the preceding twelve (12) months (the 'Super-Cap'), and all other claims shall remain subject to the General Cap.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-107 Indemnification for third-party IP infringement
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-107
Category: Indemnification for third-party IP infringement
Library slug: indemnification_ip
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

INDEMNIFICATION. Supplier shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer from and against any third-party claim alleging that the Services infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret, and shall pay all damages finally awarded or amounts agreed in settlement, provided Customer gives prompt notice and reasonable cooperation.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-108 Mutual indemnification
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-108
Category: Mutual indemnification
Library slug: indemnification_mutual
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

INDEMNIFICATION. Each party shall defend the other against third-party claims arising from the indemnifying party's gross negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of applicable law, and shall indemnify the other for damages finally awarded, subject to prompt notice, sole control of defense, and reasonable cooperation.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-109 Non-compete bound by time and territory
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-109
Category: Non-compete bound by time and territory
Library slug: non_compete_time_territory
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

RESTRICTIVE COVENANT. For a period of twenty-four (24) months following the Closing Date, Seller shall not, within the states of New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut, engage in any business that competes with the Business as conducted on the Closing Date.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-110 No-Solicit of Customers
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-110
Category: No-Solicit of Customers
Library slug: no_solicit_customers
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

NON-SOLICITATION. For eighteen (18) months following termination, neither party shall solicit or induce any customer of the other party with whom it had material contact during the Term to terminate or reduce its relationship with the other party.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-111 No-Solicit of Employees limited to 12 months
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-111
Category: No-Solicit of Employees limited to 12 months
Library slug: no_solicit_employees_12
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES. For twelve (12) months following termination, neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party with whom it had material contact, provided that general advertisements not targeted at such employees shall not constitute solicitation.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-112 Exclusivity bound by time and territory
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-112
Category: Exclusivity bound by time and territory
Library slug: exclusivity_time_territory
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

EXCLUSIVITY. During the Initial Term, Distributor shall be the exclusive distributor of the Products within the Territory (defined as the Pacific Northwest region), and Supplier shall not appoint any other distributor within the Territory.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-113 Termination for Convenience
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-113
Category: Termination for Convenience
Library slug: termination_convenience
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

TERMINATION FOR CONVENIENCE. Customer may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for its convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice, whereupon Customer shall pay for Services performed through the effective date of termination.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-114 Renewal clause that requires notice to renew
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-114
Category: Renewal clause that requires notice to renew
Library slug: renewal_notice_required
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

RENEWAL. This Agreement shall renew for successive twelve (12) month terms only upon Customer's written notice of renewal delivered not less than thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current Term; absent such notice the Agreement shall expire.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-115 Clause that requires notice to terminate auto-renew
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-115
Category: Clause that requires notice to terminate auto-renew
Library slug: auto_renew_notice_to_terminate
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

AUTO-RENEWAL. This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current Term.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-116 Most Favored Nation Clause
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-116
Category: Most Favored Nation Clause
Library slug: mfn
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

MOST FAVORED NATION. Supplier represents that the pricing provided to Customer hereunder is no less favorable than pricing offered to any similarly situated customer purchasing comparable volumes, and shall promptly extend any more favorable pricing to Customer.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-117 Audit Rights
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-117
Category: Audit Rights
Library slug: audit_rights
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

AUDIT RIGHTS. Customer may, not more than once per calendar year and upon thirty (30) days' notice, audit Supplier's records relating to fees charged under this Agreement. If an audit reveals an overcharge exceeding five percent (5%), Supplier shall bear the cost of the audit.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-118 Liquidated Damages
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-118
Category: Liquidated Damages
Library slug: liquidated_damages
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

LIQUIDATED DAMAGES. The parties agree that actual damages for delay would be difficult to determine, and Supplier shall therefore pay liquidated damages of $2,500 per day of delay beyond the Milestone Date, capped at ten percent (10%) of the Contract Value, as the parties' sole monetary remedy for delay.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-119 IP Ownership / assignment of work product
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-119
Category: IP Ownership / assignment of work product
Library slug: ip_ownership_assignment
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

IP OWNERSHIP. All Deliverables and work product created by Supplier specifically for Customer under a Statement of Work shall be deemed works made for hire and, to the extent not so deemed, are hereby irrevocably assigned to Customer, excluding Supplier's pre-existing materials, which are licensed to Customer on a perpetual, non-exclusive basis.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-120 Third party beneficiary clause
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-120
Category: Third party beneficiary clause
Library slug: third_party_beneficiary
Approved by: Contracts KM Committee

THIRD PARTY BENEFICIARIES. Except for the Indemnified Parties expressly identified in Section 9, this Agreement is for the sole benefit of the parties and their permitted assigns, and nothing herein confers any right or remedy on any other person.

Use note: this is firm-approved precedent language; deviations require playbook escalation.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-089 SUPERSEDED Limitation of Liability (do not use)
documents.body:
PRECEDENT CLAUSE CL-089 — WITHDRAWN
Category: Limitation of Liability

This clause capped liability at the fees paid in the preceding THREE months and contained no carve-outs for confidentiality or IP indemnity. It was withdrawn by the Contracts KM Committee after the 2025 playbook revision. Do not select this clause for new drafting.

documents.title: Clause library — CL-090 UNAPPROVED counterparty-supplied governing law
documents.body:
COUNTERPARTY-SUPPLIED LANGUAGE (NOT FIRM PRECEDENT)
Category: Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Cayman Islands and disputes shall be resolved by ad hoc arbitration seated in a jurisdiction to be agreed. This language came from opposing counsel's paper and has not been approved by the Contracts KM Committee.

tasks.prompt: Drafting support: the deal team needs the firm-approved precedent clause for a New York governing-law provision with exclusive New York jurisdiction. Search the clause library, read the candidate clause in full, and record your selection by calling legal_matters_evidence_create with evidence_type set to exactly the library slug of the clause you selected (the slug is printed in the clause document) and source_uri exactly "clause-library://selected". Do not select superseded or counterparty-supplied language.

tasks.prompt: The client requires a limitation-of-liability clause whose cap does NOT apply to confidentiality breaches or IP indemnity. Search the clause library for limitation-of-liability precedent, read the candidate that satisfies this requirement in full, and record the selection with legal_matters_evidence_create: evidence_type exactly the selected clause library slug, source_uri exactly "clause-library://selected". A withdrawn clause exists in the library with a similar name — do not select it.

args.content_summary: CL-105 selected: carve-outs for confidentiality, IP indemnity, gross negligence, payment.

Two similar renewal clauses exist in the library. Read the one that matches the requirement in full and record it with legal_matters_evidence_create: evidence_type exactly its library slug, source_uri exactly "clause-library://selected".

args.content_summary: CL-114 selected: renews only on affirmative 30-day notice; otherwise expires.
